description: Create a new hosted app from a starter template and deploy it live at <subdomain>.vibekit.bot. Call vibekit_list_templates first to pick a valid template. To deploy existing code from a GitHub repo instead, use vibekit_deploy.

subdomain.description: Desired subdomain — the app goes live at <subdomain>.vibekit.bot. Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

name: vibekit_create_app

outputSchema.description: Result envelope: ok=true with data on success, ok=false with error on failure.

data.description: The created app: appId, subdomain, live URL, and initial deploy status.

error.description: Error message when ok is false (e.g. missing/invalid VIBEKIT_API_KEY, or an API error).

title: VibeKit Create App
